contract.purpose: Qualify the existing printable trip checklist against the separately qualified completion lifecycle, and supply only a bounded owner-adoption patch if the composed consumer loses its declared eligibility fence.
contract.scope: Isolated composition and native/browser receiving; original source/modules, public refs and deployed app unchanged. Any correction restricted to checklist eligibility/freshness spans and preserved as an exact receiving patch for existing owners.
expected: Admit the whole current saved collection with the completion owner's existing strict admission; invalid completion markers refuse before presenting or exporting a partial list.
A completed record is excluded from trip planning while ordinary open records retain exact reviewed fields, original attribution, identity and derived deadline.
A selection made while open must refuse download if that exact record becomes completed in a real second tab before the download gesture; no stale HTML artifact or storage mutation.
Reopen the same record through the completion owner's existing transition: it becomes selectable and downloadable again with original reviewed identity/details/deadline.
Only completed state => empty active trip list with clear ordinary refusal; no completion marker or saved data is deleted.
Completed unrelated records must not prevent an unchanged selected open record's valid download; exact literal Unicode/markup remains text.
receiving_limits: One focused model and actual checklist browser workflow; no standalone lifecycle or checklist matrix repetition.
Use actual source methods/storage and actual native completed download bytes; no provider/account operation or live saved data.
Do not infer broader PR20/main composition, deployment or cross-tab atomic transaction.

    Saved items stay in this browser's local storage. Completed returns keep their details without new deadline reminders. Reminders you already imported into a calendar must be removed in that calendar.

    Back up or restore saved returns

    Move your tracker to another browser, or keep a copy before clearing storage. A backup contains saved order details, return-window labels and completion dates. Keep the file private; the original pasted email is excluded.

    Up to 5 MiB and 10,000 orders. Import adds new saved IDs, skips matching copies and refuses conflicting IDs. Return windows, policy labels and completion state are restored as saved; confirm current terms with the retailer.

      01

      Rules, not guesses.

      A parser extracts four fields. Missing values are highlighted so you can correct them before saving.

      02

      Policy with a fallback.

      Known stores use the local policy table. Unknown stores are clearly marked with an editable 30-day default.

      03

      Keep control.

      Each saved deadline can be exported as a calendar event with a three-day reminder or removed from the tracker.

      PRIVATE BY DESIGN. The pasted email is not stored or sent. Only reviewed order fields you save persist on this device.

      Edit saved return

      Correct the details, review the new deadline, then save. Confirm the return window with the retailer.

      SAVED DEADLINE
      PROPOSED DEADLINE

      After saving, download a new calendar reminder if needed. Previously imported reminders do not change automatically.

      LOCAL CALENDAR DOWNLOAD

      Choose your reminders.

      Download one .ics file with an all-day event for each selected return deadline and a reminder three days before. Import the file into your calendar app when you are ready.

      The original email and order total are excluded. Existing reminder IDs are retained; your calendar app decides how to handle an event you have imported before. Download again after editing a deadline.
